sense: to wish to have or do something

pins.definition: To wish for a thing, or to have the desire to do something.
To have a strong wish, intention, or plan to do or have something.
To feel a desire for something or to wish to do something.

situation: A young boy stands in front of a brightly lit toy store window at dusk, pressing his hands against the glass while staring intensely at a model train set inside.
subject: the intense longing and focused desire for an object just out of reach
brief: A boy stands close to a large shop window at twilight, his hands flat against the cold glass as he stares at a glowing train set on display inside. His entire posture leans forward toward the object of his desire, isolated from the bustling street behind him.
prompt: A boy stands close to a large shop window at twilight, his hands flat against the cold glass as he stares at a glowing train set on display inside.
